scope: Normal/off, no FEC, 10Mbps/dir (UDP5/TCP5), 4 TCP streams, 2% netem, 200ms one-way, 60s steady, 99%1287B UDP payload

kernel_tcp.warning: At before-steady, server cwnd_sum1551 includes transient single-socket cwnd1420; use steady end value and per-flow distribution cautiously.

model.qualification: Analytical sensitivity model only; kernel uses actual Linux congestion control. This is not measured TCP delivery or a qualified Reno prediction.

old_project_comparison.design: Separate application-layer TCPTransmit reliability window defaults MaxInFlight16 chunks, RTO500ms, MaxRetransmits8, MaxReorderBytes16*MaxPayload. Older fast repair uses cumulative SACK/RACK witness and genuine reordering window.
old_project_comparison.decision: Do not port that second ordered reliable transport into current Linux TUN of native TCP. Keep Linux TCP ownership and one outer same-PN repair; distinguish transport congestion via 8-flow realistic high-RTT workload before changing product retry/quota.

important_limits: 2% observed UDP residual is not necessarily identical to inner TCP segment loss probability; Reno sqrt is illustrative only
Host and product no loss after TUN read does not imply inner TCP unaffected by residual outer loss or reordering
Do not increase M1/MTU/netem queues: 699/733 peak of1024 and no source drops
Do not silently raise retry allowance or relax original UDP 0.25%
Cross-VM flow4 vs flow8 CPU not causal; compare only independent capacity qualification
next_decision: One distinct flow8 mixed Normal business Action on same frozen product, same loss/delay/rate and source; report actual TCP goodput/cwnd/notsent/p99 and CPU/RSS. Stop pressure ladder if flow8 fails to meet actual injection target.
